annotations.title: News headline search (GDELT, multi-language + tone timeline)

description: [PAID — 0.009 USDC on Base via x402] Multi-language, multi-country news headline search plus an optional volume/tone timeline, built on the GDELT Project's free, keyless DOC 2.0 API (100+ languages, updated every 15min). Body { query } required; optional timespan (1h..3m), language, country, domain filters, min_tone/max_tone, sort (date|relevance), max_records (1-50). Pass mode:"timeline" for a per-period volume+avg-tone series instead of an article list. Returns headlines/URLs/source metadata only and always links out to the original publisher — never relays article body text. $0.009 USDC on Base, paid via x402 by the calling agent's own wallet. Call with no payment_header first to receive the payment requirements; your own wallet pays, never this server's.

country.description: GDELT source-country name, single token, e.g. 'unitedstates'.

domain.description: Restrict to one publishing domain, e.g. 'nytimes.com'.

language.description: GDELT source-language name, single token, e.g. 'english'.

max_tone.description: Only articles with GDELT tone below this value (-100..100).

min_tone.description: Only articles with GDELT tone above this value (-100..100).

payment_header.description: Optional. Omit on your first call to receive the x402 payment challenge for free. After your own wallet/x402 client signs against that challenge, call this same tool again with the SAME business arguments plus this field set to the header your x402 client produced (typically { name: "PAYMENT-SIGNATURE", value: "<base64 payload>" }). This server never holds a wallet and never pays on your behalf.

name.description: HTTP header name to attach, e.g. PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.

value.description: HTTP header value (the signed payment payload).
